$comment: The stock Node runtime piorbit ships and spawns the host from (M5-T2).
Pinned to the same Node line Electron 44 bundles (24.20), so the host, the
workers and Electron's own renderer all agree about what `node` means.
The checksums are the ones published in https://nodejs.org/dist/v<version>/SHASUMS256.txt,
copied here on purpose: verifying a download against a hash fetched from the
same server at the same moment proves nothing. These live in git, so a
tampered mirror fails the build instead of shipping.
Bumping the version is a task with its own row: update `version`, replace
every hash from the new SHASUMS256.txt, and re-run `pnpm -F @piorbit/desktop runtime`.
